simple.meaning: בָּתַק (bâthaq) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to cut in pieces.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 16:40. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּתַק (H1333) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בָּתַק (bâthaq) / H1333 is traced through Ezekiel 16:40 with source-language evidence and verse context.
